thread:
maria (sec): FYI — upstream advisories for two Go issues that look relevant to us: CVE-2026-0543 (gRPC header parsing overflow) and CVE-2026-0544 (oauth/jwt replay/validation edge case). Seen in grpc v1.60.x and some oauth/jwt forks. Need quick triage. @ken @raj
ken (eng-platform): Can you paste the advisory links? which services talk to external clients?
raj (infra): API gateway + inference-runtime public endpoints + private-agent (used for on-prem control plane) all vendor grpc clients. Gateway uses google.golang.org/grpc v1.60.2 in main.
elle (sre): exploitability? p0/p1?
maria (sec): Initial notes from NVD + upstream PRs — exploitation requires crafted headers or token reuse; upstream says "high" for token replay in some flows, "medium" for header parsing. I'd treat API gateway as high priority. Link: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xxxx-yyyy (internal memo posted)
dependabot: Automated PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 — bump google.golang.org/grpc v1.60.2 -> v1.61.0.
ken (eng-platform): Thanks. I’ll open a parallel PR to pin github.com/golang-jwt/jwt to v3.2.2 and replace any deprecated jwt forks. We should avoid transitive floats.
maria (sec): Also note: jwt lib change may require token re-signing/compat checks. If we pin to a newer validator that rejects old tokens, we may need key rollover coordination with KMS. @raj can you estimate KMS rotation impact?
raj (infra): KMS impact: zero-downtime rotation possible but we need to coordinate with mobile/web teams for token TTLs. I estimate ~2–3 hours to stage rotated keys and a canary rollout in Dedicated env.
elle (sre): Recommend emergency canary: 5% traffic to patched gateway in us-west1, monitor 5xx/token-err spikes. deploy-bot: Canary pool ready -> pool/gateway-canary-1
maria (sec): Mitigations while patching: add WAF rule to drop requests with >N headers, strict header length; add token replay detection (simple in-memory cache at gateway) for 1m window. Not a replacement but helps.
ken (eng-platform): Proposed go.mod diff (short):
```
require (
    google.golang.org/grpc v1.61.0
    github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v3.2.2
)
replace github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go => github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v3.2.2
```
ken (eng-platform): We'll run full test matrix (unit + integration for signing/validation). Any services that vendor the old jwt?
maria (sec): Search shows a couple of internal libs still pulling old jwt via replace. I'll open an inventory doc.
raj (infra): Timeline proposal: patch PRs in next 4 hours, canary deploy in 8 hours, full rollout in 24–36h if no regressions. If exploit PoC appears, escalate to emergency rollback and full patch within 8h.
maria (sec): Risk classification: API gateway = P1. inference-runtime = P2 (internal only), private-agent = P1 for enterprise customers (we must prioritize).
elle (sre): Add monitoring hooks: token-failure-rate, header-parse-errors, grpc-conn-errors. I'll add dashboards and alerts.
maria (sec): Action items: 
- ken: create PRs for gateway + infra libs (due EOD).
- raj: prep KMS rotation plan and canary cluster (due EOD).
- elle: dashboards/alerts + canary alarm thresholds (due EOD).
- maria: coordinate vendor advisory and customer comms draft.
Reactions: :eyes: :thumbsup:
ken (eng-platform): ack, starting branch now.
dependabot: NOTE: also created PR for private-agent repo: https://github.com/redwood/private-agent/pull/98
maria (sec): Thanks everyone. Post status updates in this thread; add —incident tag only if we shift to emergency.
elle (sre): If anyone finds failing token validations during tests, ping me immediately.
(End of thread)
